codeReview.summary: Solid implementation. MissionPanel is a pure presentational component wrapped in React.memo with useMemo for computed values. useMissionState cleanly separates dispatch logic with conversation_id filtering and bounded progress log (N=100). The 6 mission_* cases are correctly placed BEFORE the default branch in useAcpMessage.ts (lines 305-314), ensuring running/aiProcessing is never flipped. Cancel/abort delegates to the existing handleStop → resetState path which correctly sets running=false, aiProcessing=false. Mission data resets when sessionMode switches away from 'mission' via useEffect in AcpSendBox.tsx (line 133). i18n keys added in all 6 locales. All 37 tests pass (18 MissionPanel + 19 useAcpMessage).

issues.description: No dedicated test for bounded progress log (N=100 cap). The test file header mentions 'progress log bounding' but only tests rendering entries — never verifies the slice behavior when >100 entries are dispatched. The bounding logic in useMissionState.ts:80 is correct in code, but untested. Since useMissionState has no standalone test file, this specific edge case lacks coverage.

No test for cancel/abort restoring base runtime state (VAL-MISSION-014). The cancel flow uses the existing handleStop → resetState path in AcpSendBox, which is an integration concern not easily unit-tested, but a test verifying resetState() clears running/aiProcessing would strengthen coverage.

React 'act(...)' warnings appear during test execution for state updates. While all tests pass, the warnings indicate some state updates are not properly wrapped — could cause flaky tests in stricter React versions.

No test for bounded progress log N=100. useMissionState.ts PROGRESS_LOG_LIMIT=100 slice logic at line 80 is correct but untested — the test header mentions 'progress log bounding' yet only tests rendering.
No test for cancel/abort restoring base runtime state (VAL-MISSION-014). Cancel path uses existing handleStop→resetState in AcpSendBox which is correct but lacks direct test coverage.
React act(...) warnings in test output. Tests pass but state update warnings may indicate fragility.

summary: Feature passes review. MissionPanel is correctly implemented as a pure presentational component with React.memo and useMemo. useMissionState manages state for 6 mission events with conversation_id filtering and bounded progress log. The 6 mission_* cases are placed BEFORE the default branch in useAcpMessage, preventing running/aiProcessing from being flipped. MissionPanel conditionally mounts when sessionMode==='mission' and resets cleanly on mode switch. i18n keys added in all 6 locales. 37 tests pass covering all required data-testids, state transitions, feature rendering, worker badges, heartbeat display, and mission event handling. Three non-blocking issues noted: (1) no dedicated test for N=100 progress log bounding, (2) no test for cancel/abort restoring base state, (3) React act() warnings in test output.
